verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a docs framework with a CLI, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no documented capability to bulk-edit, bulk-move or bulk-act on many items. The versioning CLI snapshots the docs directory and the build compiles all files, but these are adjacent features, not user-directed bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
